{{Quote|The Appropriations Committee approached me with the idea of constructing a dome near the Senate Building that will also serve as a docking facility.|Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, referring to the construction of the Republic Executive Building|<ref name="DP" />}}
The '''Republic Executive Building'''&mdash;also known as the '''Senate Office Building''', '''Executive Annex Dome''' and '''Senate Annex'''&mdash;was a large, domed administration building that also functioned as a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City's]] [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Sponsored by the [[Financial Appropriations Committee]] and constructed several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Executive Building was the official [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|residence]] and principal workplace of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the leader of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Palpatine resided in the Executive Building for a time as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor of]] [[The galaxy/Legends|the Galaxy]] before relocating to the much larger [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]].

==History==
===Conception===
{{Quote|I would have thought you at least wanted me to see your new office. Then I recalled what you said last time we spoke, about our not being seen together in public.''"<br />"''The office is temporary. One more suited to the position is already in the planning stages.|Dooku, and Chancellor Palpatine|<ref name="DP" />}}
[[File:SenateDistrict-SS.png|thumb|left|250px|The Republic Executive Building in the foreground, opposite of the Senate Building]]
In the midst of the [[Crisis on Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], then-[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was disappointed in the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor's]] [[Chancellor's working office/Legends|office]], believing that the [[Head of State/Legends|head of state]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] required a workplace that better reflected his position as leader of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. The view of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Galactic City/Legends|cityscape]] from the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] appealed to Palpatine, who had secretly plotted to replace [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] as chancellor, but the office itself was too small for his liking. Convinced that no amount of remodeling would satisfy his expectations, Palpatine envisioned the construction of a new building&mdash;an executive office building that would serve as the nerve center for his [[New Order/Legends|future regime]].<ref name="DP" />

Secretly, Palpatine's true identity was [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] affiliated with the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]], an [[Sith/Legends|ancient cult]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|wielders]] committed to the downfall of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Soon after Palpatine's [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|election]] to the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|highest office]] in the state, the [[Financial Appropriations Committee]] proposed to finance the construction of a new building that would serve as the executive branch's principle workplace, to which the Chancellor approved. Hence, the Republic Executive Building was created in the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]], adjacent to the Senate Building, and also served as a [[Spaceport/Legends|docking facility]]<ref name="DP" /> with several tiered [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] levels.<ref name="AOTC" /> In addition to its executive role, the new structure was an annex to the Senate's delegation offices, and also included [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|private rooms and an office]] designed according to Palpatine's specifications.<ref name="DP" /> For more than a decade,<ref name="AOTC" /><ref name="ROTS" /> Chancellor Palpatine resided in the Executive Building, all the while [[Grand Plan/Legends|plotting]] to bring about the re-ascendancy of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] as rulers of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="DP" />

===The last years of the Old Republic===
[[File:Republic_Exec_Bldg_Nite.png|thumb|right|250px|The Executive Building at night]]
At the height of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Supreme Chancellor Palpatine held several meetings with the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] in his office at the Executive Building, discussing options aimed at the preservation of the Galactic Republic. Around the same time, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] sent a report to the Chancellor's office, in which he revealed his discovery of a secret [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]], built by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] in preparation for a [[Clone Wars/Legends|civil war]]. At the behest of [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]], Palpatine secured [[Emergency Powers Act/Legends|emergency powers]] with the Senate's majority support, and then activated a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone army]] in response to the Separatist Rebellion.<ref name="AOTC" /> As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Chancellor spent much of his time in the Executive Building, where he coordinated many strategies with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] whom he appointed as [[Jedi General/Legends|generals]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="CWTV">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''</ref>

Early in the conflict, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] led a team of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] on a mission to rescue [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], the [[Prisoner/Legends|incarcerated]] uncle of a [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] known as [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] [[Hutt/Legends|the Hutt]]. In order to achieve their objective, the bounty [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] infiltrated the Senate Building and took several senators hostage, killing numerous [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]] in the process. They also disabled the power grid in the Republic Executive Building, causing the structure to initiate an automatic lock-down. Chancellor Palpatine, trapped in his office and unable to communicate with the outside world, was contacted by Bane and coerced into releasing Ziro in exchange for the senators' lives. A [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|shock troopers]] were deployed to the building for the Chancellor's protection, but the hunters ultimately escaped from Coruscant with Ziro.<ref name="Hostage">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref>

As the Clone Wars progressed, a [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]]&mdash;believed to be the last of a [[Species/Legends|species]] long since considered extinct&mdash;was captured and transferred from [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] to Coruscant on the orders of Chancellor Palpatine.<ref name="TZB">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast}}</ref> Fascinated by the beast's [[Armor/Legends|armor]]-like skin that was impervious to [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], Palpatine had it deposited in the [[Republic Science and Technical Center/Legends|Republic Science and Technical Center]] for further analysis. The creature escaped, however, and proceeded on a [[Zillo Beast incident/Legends|rampage]] through the [[City/Legends|city]]. Dozens of buildings path were damaged and many civilians were [[Death/Legends|killed]] as the zillo beast tracked Palpatine to his office in the Republic Executive Building. The Chancellor attempted to escape in his [[H-2 executive shuttle/Legends|H-2 executive shuttle]], but the zillo beast caught the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in its grip. A [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], led by several members of the Jedi Council, arrived on the scene and promptly killed the beast with [[Gas bomb/Legends|gas bombs]] containing Malastarian [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] that was [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] to the creature.<ref name="TZBSB">{{TCW|The Zillo Beast Strikes Back}}</ref>

Shortly after the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Jedi generals Obi-Wan Kenobi and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] escorted Chancellor Palpatine to the Executive Building's docking area where they met with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and a retinue of [[Loyalist/Legends|Loyalist]] politicians.<ref name="ROTS" /> Meanwhile, on the lower levels, a clandestine organization of senators known as the [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]] met with the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Tobb Jadak]] in order to use his ship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']] for a covert mission. Utilizing an encrypted device aboard the ship, the senators safely departed the Executive Building before a group of [[Coruscant Guard/Legends|Coruscant Guard]] [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]] could detain them.<ref name="MF novel">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>

[[File:SenateDistrict-ROTS.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Executive Building, situated in front of the Senate Building, in the last days of the Old Republic]]
In the days following of the Battle of Coruscant, Palpatine met with Skywalker in his office at the Executive Building and appointed the Jedi Knight as his personal representative on the Jedi High Council. The Council allowed the appointment to stand, but only for the purpose of using Skywalker to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on the activities of the Chancellor, whose motives they had come to distrust. The Executive Building was also the site where the [[Delegation of 2000]] made its existence known to the Chancellor. Composed of a group of senators who disagreed with the numerous amendments to the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|Constitution]], the Delegation confronted Palpatine in his office with a [[Petition of 2000|petition]] of two thousand like-minded delegates that advocated for a peaceful conclusion to the war. The Chancellor assured them of his support for a restoration of democracy, although the vagueness of his intentions and dismissive attitude toward their questions left the Delegation of 2000 more concerned for the future of the Republic.<ref name="ROTS" />

====Showdown in the Executive Building====
{{Quote|I ''am'' the Senate."<br />"''Not yet.''"<br />"It's treason, then.|Darth Sidious, and Mace Windu, seconds before their duel in the Executive Building|<ref name="ROTS" />}}
[[File:PalpatineAnakin-JvS.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Anakin Skywalker becomes Darth Vader in the Executive Building.]]
With the death of General Grievous at the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]], Master Windu and three of his fellow members on the Jedi Council&mdash;[[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]]&mdash;left the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and headed to the Executive Building. Moments before their departure, Skywalker told Windu about his discovery of Palpatine's secret identity as Darth Sidious, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who engineered the Separatist Crisis and the Clone Wars. When the Jedi confronted the Chancellor in his private office, Sidious swiftly struck down three of the Masters and engaged Windu in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]], resulting in a [[Showdown on Coruscant|showdown]] between the Jedi and Sith in the Republic Executive Building.<ref name="ROTS" />

Mace Windu's death at the hands of Darth Sidious not only affected the fate of the Galactic Republic and the Jedi Order, but also caused Anakin Skywalker's fall to the dark side of the Force. Driven by the [[Force vision/Legends|premonition]] of his [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|secret wife's]] death in childbirth and convinced that Sidious had the power to restore life, Skywalker attacked Windu in defense of the Chancellor, making him complicit in the Jedi Master's demise. Though remorseful for his actions, Skywalker relented to Sidious's offer and joined the Sith as the Dark Lord's new [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]. As the newly-christened Darth Vader led the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] on a [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|mission]] to [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|purge]] the Jedi Temple of all inhabitants, Sidious remained in the Executive Building where he issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] to the clone [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] dispersed throughout the galaxy, causing them to betray and murder their Jedi officers without question or debate.<ref name="ROTS" /> Following the completion of his assault on the Jedi Temple, Vader at his master's behest then left for [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] to [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|kill the Separatist council]] and deactivate their droid armies, effectively ending the war

Without the Jedi Order, Palpatine's opponents in the Senate were powerless to prevent his complete takeover of the state. In a [[Declaration of a New Order|speech]] that condemned the "Jedi Rebellion" and the inefficiencies of the Old Republic, Palpatine proclaimed the formation of the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], ruled by himself as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|emperor]].<ref name="ROTS" />

===Galactic Empire===
In the months following the rise of the New Order, Emperor Palpatine no longer occupied the Executive Building. His official residence had been moved to the heavily-renovated [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]], formerly known as the Presidential Palace in the Old Republic. Despite the relocation, the Emperor still utilized his former office on occasion, mainly to meet with members of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] and other guests. The building also contained secret chambers for the purpose of interrogation via [[Torture/Legends|torture]]&mdash;an experience that Padawan [[Dama Montalvo]] endured at the hands of Darth Vader, who sought information on the whereabouts of Obi-Wan Kenobi.<ref name="Purge">[[Purge (comic book)|''Purge'']]</ref>

==Layout==
[[File:Senatorial_docking_bays.png|thumb|left|250px|The Executive Building's tiered docking bays]]
Erected within the Legislative Borough of the Senate District, the Republic Executive Building was built over the old foundations of the [[Coruscant Spaceport]],<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> a docking facility that existed during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> A massive dome, situated at the center of several broad thoroughfares, was the largest of several annexes in close vicinity to the Senate Building. Designed to complement the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Great Rotunda]], the Executive Building alleviated the cramped office conditions in the Senate Building caused by the increased number of seats doled out to new member worlds. Aside from its status as a political administration facility, the Executive Building contained several levels of hangar bays and landing pads for the official [[Transport/Legends|transports]] of government officials.<ref name="SWCL" />

The Supreme Chancellor's offices were located in the higher levels of the building, from which Palpatine conducted meetings with the Loyalist Committee, delegation leaders and members of the Jedi High Council. Along the exterior of the building, enhanced security measures ensured the safety of the Chancellor from potential [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] attacks and assassination attempts.<ref name="SWCL" /> In addition to the Chancellor's Suite, several prominent senators also had their own offices within the building, including Padmé Amidala of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]],<ref name="Hostage" /> and [[Mee Deechi/Legends|Mee Deechi]] of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]].<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>

The highest tier of the Executive Building's multi-level landing dock was reserved for senators and delegation leaders with offices in the building. Executive [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] and gunships were contained in the docking area in order to accommodate guests, ranging from [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]] to planetary rulers and members of the Jedi Order. Attendant [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[Load lifter (machine)|load lifters]] and [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] automatons were assigned to assist Republic officials on each level; larger vessels, such as [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]], [[Skiff/Legends|star skiffs]] and [[Light freighter/Legends|light stock]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] could dock in the wider landing bays on the lower tiers. The main docking level deposited visitors into the cavernous, open-air [[Atrium of the Senate Office Building|atrium]] that led deep into the Executive Building's labyrinthine interior.<ref name="ROTS" />
